- Build a complete, playable, responsive 2D mobile/tablet trading-card game inspired by Hazbin Hotel, Helluva Boss, and Dandy’s World.
- Show the cards individually for the user to review and suggest changes.

- Start with a mode-selection screen: Expanded, Standard, Unrestricted, Metal, and Jumbo formats, each with normal/ranked options as specified.

- Make the game usable on phones and tablets.

- Created a self-contained browser game using plain HTML, CSS, and JavaScript because no app framework or existing game was present.

  open [url]                  open the browser

- Build a complete, playable, responsive 2D mobile/tablet trading-card game inspired by Hazbin Hotel, Helluva Boss, and Dandy’s World.
- Display cards individually for review and allow changes based on user feedback.

- Include Expanded, Standard, Unrestricted, Metal, and Jumbo formats, each with normal and ranked options.
- Include a shop with packs, singles, blisters, collections, stamped/signed upgrades, accessories, and vendor selling.

- Make the game usable on phones and tablets.

## Objective
- Build a complete, playable, responsive 2D mobile/tablet trading-card game inspired by Hazbin Hotel, Helluva Boss, and Dandy’s World.
- Display cards individually for review and allow changes based on user feedback.

## Requirements
- Include Expanded, Standard, Unrestricted, Metal, and Jumbo formats, each with normal and ranked options.
- Include a shop with packs, singles, blisters, collections, stamped/signed upgrades, accessories, and vendor selling.
- Support 150-card and separate 60-card decks, a binder, Friday collection contest, five bunkers with up to five characters each, rock-paper-scissors and coin toss, seven-card opening hand, 15 prizes, energy attachments, and attacks that end turns.
- Make the game usable on phones and tablets.

## Decisions
- Use a self-contained browser game with plain HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
- Use original emoji-and-gradient card mockups and prototype effects rather than external character artwork.
- Start players with sample cards and prebuilt decks; simplify unspecified rules as prototypes.

- Implemented the app shell, navigation, mode selection, card catalog/review, shop, binder, deck builders, bunker setup, and battle interface.
- Added purchase and sale flows, packs and card inspection, Friday voting, deck editing/validation, and battle setup and turn interactions.
- Added battle, modal, card-detail, and responsive styling.

## Objective
- Build a complete, playable, responsive 2D mobile/tablet trading-card game inspired by Hazbin Hotel, Helluva Boss, and Dandy’s World.
- Display cards individually for review and allow changes based on user feedback.

## Requirements
- Include Expanded, Standard, Unrestricted, Metal, and Jumbo formats, each with normal and ranked options.
- Include a shop with packs, singles, blisters, collections, stamped/signed upgrades, accessories, and vendor selling.
- Support 150-card and separate 60-card decks, a binder, Friday collection contest, five bunkers with up to five characters each, rock-paper-scissors and coin toss, seven-card opening hand, 15 prizes, energy attachments, and attacks that end turns.
- Make the game usable on phones and tablets.

## Decisions
- Use a self-contained browser game with plain HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
- Use original emoji-and-gradient card mockups and prototype effects rather than external character artwork.
- Start players with sample cards and prebuilt decks; simplify unspecified rules as prototypes.

- Added purchase and sale flows, packs and card inspection, Friday voting, deck editing/validation, and battle setup and turn interactions.
- Added battle, modal, card-detail, and responsive styling.
- Fixed modal dismissal handling in `app.js`; verified `node --check app.js` and successfully reopened the collection view in Playwright.
- Created `screenshots/current.png` and captured/inspected a screenshot.

- Verify shop, collection/binder, deck building, match setup, battle turns, and mobile layouts; fix any issues found.
